Shashi Bhushan vs The State Of Jharkhand on 13 September,
2024

Bench: Anil Kumar Choudhary
 In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
 Aba No. 5827 of 2024
 Shashi Bhushan, S/o Late Ram Naresh Ram, aged about 32 years, R/o

 Bihar-821310 ...

entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The State of Jharkhand
2. Victim/ Informant ...

Opp. Parties Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anil Kumar Choudhary
For the Petitioner : Mr. Saumya Pandey , Adv.
 For the State : Mr. Sushma Aind , Addl.PP

For the opp. party no.2 : Mr. Kumar Basant Narayan , Adv.
03 / 13.09.2024 Heard the parties.

Apprehending his arrest, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail in connection B.S. City Mahila P.S. Case No. 10 of 2023 registered under Sections 376 (2) (n), 506/ 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: B.S. City Mahila P.S. Case No. 10 of 2023
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that this is the second journey of the petitioner, with the anticipatory bail and the earlier prayer of anticipatory bail of the petitioner was rejected on merit but the fresh ground is that in the meanwhile, the informant victim has solemnized marriage as per Hindu rites and rituals with the petitioner on 02.02.2024 and in this respect, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the opp. party no. 2 jointly draws attention of the court to the counter affidavit filed on behalf of the informant - opp. party no. 2 wherein the informant has stated that she has solemnized marriage with the petitioner as per the Hindu Rites and Customs on 02.02.2024, hence she is not desirous to proceed further with the case and she and the petitioner, have amicably settled the dispute.
It is next submitted that the petitioner is ready to co-operate with the investigation of the case hence, the petitioner be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.
The learned Addl. PP opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner.

sentences.text: Considering aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to grant the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Hence, in the event of arrest by the police or surrender within a period of six weeks from the date of this order, the petitioner shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned JMFC, Bokaro in connection with B.S. City Mahila P.S. Case No. 10 of 2023 subject to the condition that the petitioner will co-operate with the Investigation of the case and will appear before the Investigating Officer as and when noticed by him and will submit mobile number and photocopy of Aadhaar card at the time of surrender in the court below with an undertaking not to change mobile phone number during the pendency of the case along with the other conditions laid down under section 438 (2) Cr. P.C. (ANIL KUMAR CHOUDHARY, J.)
Smita/-

opennyai_summary.arguments:
Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that this is the second journey of the petitioner, with the anticipatory bail and the earlier prayer of anticipatory bail of the petitioner was rejected on merit but the fresh ground is that in the meanwhile, the informant victim has solemnized marriage as per Hindu rites and rituals with the petitioner on 02.02.2024 and in this respect, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the opp. party no. 2 jointly draws attention of the court to the counter affidavit filed on behalf of the informant - opp. party no. 2 wherein the informant has stated that she has solemnized marriage with the petitioner as per the Hindu Rites and Customs on 02.02.2024, hence she is not desirous to proceed further with the case and she and the petitioner, have amicably settled the dispute.
It is next submitted that the petitioner is ready to co-operate with the investigation of the case hence, the petitioner be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Considering aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to grant the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
Hence, in the event of arrest by the police or surrender within a period of six weeks from the date of this order, the petitioner shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned JMFC, Bokaro in connection with B.S. Case No. 10 of 2023 subject to the condition that the petitioner will co-operate with the Investigation of the case and will appear before the Investigating Officer as and when noticed by him and will submit mobile number and photocopy of Aadhaar card at the time of surrender in the court below with an undertaking not to change mobile phone number during the pendency of the case along with the other conditions laid down under section 438 (2) Cr. P.C. (ANIL KUMAR CHOUDHARY, J.)
